# The Philadelphia Inquirer

> > Philadelphia's leading news source covering local journalism, arts and culture, with extensive coverage of Abbott Elementary, Philadelphia institutions like the Barnes Foundation, and community engagement.

The Philadelphia Inquirer (Inquirer.com) serves as the region's primary news outlet, delivering comprehensive coverage of Philadelphia arts, culture, and civic life. The site features in-depth reporting on local institutions, cultural figures like Quinta Brunson, and community-focused journalism initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Philadelphia
- Abbott Elementary
- Quinta Brunson
- Barnes Foundation
- West Philadelphia
- Community journalism
- Arts and culture coverage
- Online moderation and platform policy
- Local television and entertainment
- Philadelphia museums and institutions
- Public art and sculpture
- Theater and performance
- Emmy nominations
- User engagement
- Anti-racism initiatives
